title: Produce pull-driven asynchronous results (experimental)
goal: Author a bounded experimental F# asynchronous producer when callers need incremental results, cancellation propagation and awaited cleanup on early exit or failure.

selectionNotes: Statically known inline recipes; no raw concurrent move/dispose, opaque recipes, optimized tail handoff, automatic cancellation of non-cancellable work, AOT or complete debugger support.

evidence.scope: Actual .NET 10 dependency restore, compilation and execution of the original task-based asynchronous enumerator: pending pull, incremental results and delayed early disposal exactly once. No runtime-async, Native AOT or GA proof.

Actual .NET 11 dependency restore, preview compilation and execution of original intrinsic-based sequence support: pending moves, incremental results, exhaustion, serial overlap rejection, nested cancellation and its limits, delayed early/nested/exceptional cleanup and exception precedence. Separate negative compiler probes are documented in docs/verification/PIN-982-984.md. No Native AOT, complete debugger or GA proof.

humanProof.scope: Automated managed sequence execution and negative compiler probes establish the bounded producer/lifetime claims. Native AOT, other-platform execution, complete debugger stepping and GA proof are not claimed.
